verdict.rationale: YPOG's notary practice explicitly offers GmbH/UG formation services (a 'Starterkit GmbH-foundation', foundation questionnaires, notarizations in German/English) and the firm's corporate/VC practice broadly serves 'emerging tech companies' and founders, supporting a general incorporation capability. However, the evidence never documents the specific US-style deliverables named in the story (charter, bylaws, board consents, founder stock purchase agreements) — these map to German GmbH/UG formation instruments (articles of association, shareholder resolutions) rather than the named documents, and no evidence packages formation as an end-to-end turnkey engagement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bylaws/board-consent-equivalent deliverables, founder stock purchase agreement templates, and a described formation engagement workflow.
